diagnosis.cause: The prepared verifier sentinels and final verifier bindings can produce different whole-program register allocation. In the observed build the provisional installer spilled through absolute storage while the final-header installer used zero-page storage.
diagnosis.ship_relevance: The provisional bootstrap link is not shipped. It exists only to derive the final verifier header.
diagnosis.old_gate_error: It required byte identity between a deliberately provisional link and the final-header product link, conflating header derivation with final installer reproducibility.
diagnosis.discarded_intermediate_fix: A second independent final-header link was also rejected: whole-program code generation is not a stable byte-identity boundary across separate link invocations, even with identical generated headers.

fix.header_derivation: The provisional bootstrap link continues to derive the verifier header.
fix.slice_binding: The final runtime-overlay pack still runs header-mode verify against every generated verifier binding.
fix.installer_binding: The shipped runtime-overlay image and manifest are reconstructed from the one final product ELF and must match it exactly. This covers all 44 slices, including slot 37 resident-island-installer, without treating a separate compilation as an identity oracle.
fix.fail_closed: Any byte difference between a final-ELF slice and the packed image, any manifest/input mismatch, or any verifier-header mismatch stops the product build.

identity_policy: The build-contract change is allowed to change the resolved profile and product identity; the regular varied double-build and R3/R4/R5/R6 chain must repin it.
claim_limit: This diagnosis proves the corrected final-ELF-to-package binding but records a six-byte installer-slice headroom debit caught by the existing C1 gate. It does not authorize that debit, prove the forthcoming varied double-build, promote a product set, or claim G3/G5/G6 evidence.
